reason: IIS sends Server: Microsoft-IIS/10.0; webForCore's host is Kestrel.

A URL outside the application is IIS's site's: its native 404.0 page (the site's root is empty). On webForCore it goes on to the rest of the ASP.NET Core pipeline, which ends with an empty 404. Same status.
IIS's native 404.0 page for a URL outside the application is text/html; ASP.NET Core's empty 404 has no Content-Type.
IIS's site adds X-Powered-By: ASP.NET (applicationHost.config) to its 404 for a URL outside the application; the application's <customHeaders> don't apply there, and webForCore's empty 404 has none.
